card.name: Verb or preposition after a drug name
card.fires_on: Small words right after a drug name as subject, such as 'in' after 'is present', 'is' after 'Amitriptyline', or 'should' after a tablet name. Also some spaces before numbers in pharmacokinetic text.

modes.label: Milk and placenta statements
modes.description: Linking word after a drug name in lactation or pregnancy sentences, e.g. 'present in' or 'is excreted'.
modes.example: Nursing Mothers Hydrocodone is present<< in>> human milk.

modes.label: Space before a number
modes.description: A blank space just before a numeric value in a pharmacokinetic comparison.

modes.label: Verb after drug subject
modes.description: Auxiliary or adverb following a drug name subject.
